description: As reparse-synthetic-suffix-nested-restoration, with [U] inside a rule u. The strict prediction of u admits its production, because its one symbol, the helper of [U], can read through its restoration (engine §7.4). Here u, and the [U] in it, are predicted only strictly. A strict and an ordinary prediction of one helper at one position share their items, so a fault in the strict path shows only where that path is the only one, or comes first.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [+T] [+U] [+V]
%rule b A [+T] [+U] [+V] [+W]
%rule c A [+T u] V
%rule u [+U]
